question: A gas contained in a cylinder is compressed, the work required for compression being 5000 kJ. During this process, heat interaction of 2000 kJ causes the surroundings to be heated. The change in internal energy of the gas during the process is ______.
explanation: Using the first law of thermodynamics: Q = ΔU + W. Here, Q = -2000 kJ (heat lost), W = -5000 kJ (work done on the system). So, ΔU = Q - W = -2000 - (-5000) = +3000 kJ.
